subject: LedgerBank BCP/DR evidence: access logs, KV cache snapshots & RTO/RPO tieout
messages:
From: Claire Donovan <c.donovan@ledgerbank.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@ledgerbank.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and warm-start artifacts (SIG follow-up)

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for yesterday's SIG call. LedgerBank is working through a narrow set of evidentiary asks to close our operational risk assessment. Can you please provide the following for the warm-start / failover scenario you referenced on the call (live test dated 2026-09-22):

- RTO / RPO measurement spreadsheet (time-aligned events and verifiable timestamps).
- Representative KV cache snapshots taken at T0, T+1m, T+10m (or equivalent proof of cache rehydration).
- Access logs showing the sequence of service account invocations during the restore (redact tokens but keep timestamps and actor identifiers).
- Short (1-2 page) runbook excerpt that describes the warm-start verification steps and expected observable checks.

We'd like to review artifacts by EOD Friday 2026-10-09. If you can't meet that timeline, please propose a target and we can schedule a 15-minute sync. Also note procurement copied here for timeline/PO coordination.

Thanks,
Claire Donovan
Senior InfoSec Manager
LedgerBank

Attachments: none
From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Claire Donovan <c.donovan@ledgerbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, procurement@ledgerbank.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and warm-start artifacts (SIG follow-up)

Claire,

Appreciate the clear list — we'll pull the artifacts together. Proposed plan:

1) Deliver RTO/RPO matrix + time-aligned event log (spreadsheet) by Friday EOD.
2) Provide one compressed KV cache snapshot set and a short script to validate cache keys (redacted).
3) Include an access-log excerpt that maps to the events in the spreadsheet.
4) Attach the runbook excerpt and an ops contact for a quick walk-through.

Internal owners: Karthik will assemble the technical artifacts (matrix, snapshots, validation script); Marcus will provide the runbook excerpt and on-call rotation confirmation.

If LedgerBank wants a very short witness demo next week we can set up a 15-min call. Otherwise we'll send the packet and Claire can confirm receipt.

I'll follow up with a delivery checklist.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0128

Attachments referenced: (none in this reply)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and warm-start artifacts (SIG follow-up)

Irene,

Working on the package. Notes below so Claire sees what to expect:

- RTO/RPO matrix (rto_rpo_matrix_ledgerbank_v1.xlsx): contains event timestamps from the test run (leader election, storage mount, service init, KV rehydration start/end). We include both system clock times and monotonic offsets so the sequence is verifiable.

- KV cache snapshots (kv-cache-snapshots-20260922.tar.gz): two snapshots (T0 and T+10m) + a small manifest that lists key prefixes. Snapshot contents are redacted for customer privacy, but the manifest shows key counts and checksum hashes to tie to the run.

- Access log sample (access-log-sample-20260922.txt): contains service account id, operation, and ISO timestamps (we scrubbed auth tokens). We also include a short mapping file that correlates log lines to the spreadsheet event IDs.

- Runbook excerpt (runbook-restore-snippets.md): the excerpt includes the exact verification commands we used to ensure a warm-start was successful and the expected observability signals (KV hit-rate, request latency, error budget). Marcus will add on-call owner rotation info.

Caveats: the KV rehydration times vary slightly by deployment size; the matrix documents the sequence and measured deltas. For the SIG review, these artifacts should be sufficient to demonstrate our restore behavior and timelines.

I'll attach the tarball and spreadsheet in the outbound email to Claire unless you want to host them on a signed Drive link.

-Karthik
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments to include in final packet: rto_rpo_matrix_ledgerbank_v1.xlsx, kv-cache-snapshots-20260922.tar.gz, access-log-sample-20260922.txt, runbook-restore-snippets.md
From: Claire Donovan <c.donovan@ledgerbank.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@ledgerbank.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and warm-start artifacts (SIG follow-up)

Irene / Karthik,

This looks good and aligned with what our risk team needs. Two quick asks before you send the packet:

1) Can you include a short note (1 paragraph) describing how you ensure log integrity (rotation, immutability windows, and retention) for the access logs included?
2) Procurement would prefer a shared Drive link for large files rather than attachments. Can you provide a signed link with 30-day read access?

If you can deliver by EOD today that would be ideal — otherwise Monday morning works. Thanks for the fast turn.

Best,
Claire

Attachments: none
From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Claire Donovan <c.donovan@ledgerbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, procurement@ledgerbank.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and warm-start artifacts (SIG follow-up)

Claire,

We uploaded the packet to a signed Drive folder and included the additional log-integrity note you requested. Delivery summary below and links/attachments:

- Drive link (30-day read access): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdefLedgerDriveLink
- Files in folder: rto_rpo_matrix_ledgerbank_v1.xlsx, kv-cache-snapshots-20260922.tar.gz (manifest only), access-log-sample-20260922.txt (redacted), runbook-restore-snippets.md, log-integrity-note.md

Log-integrity note (excerpt): we write access logs to an append-only object store with write-once lifecycle, process a daily signed manifest, and retain originals for 90 days. Manifests are signed with our KMS key and checksums are recorded in an internal audit ledger correlated to the event ids in the RTO/RPO matrix.

Next steps: Marcus will schedule a short ops walk-through next week if you'd like a live demo of the warm-start sequence. Please confirm receipt and any additional evidence you need to close the SIG item.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (links provided above)
